- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/review_merge_train.sh | location: `_mt_dispatch_rb_judge`, the final `_mt_dispatch_review "${mt_rbj_pr}" "${mt_rbj_head}"` call (line 1537) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: The last-resort plain review dispatch takes `MERGE_TRAIN_ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS` from the environment (default `true`, line 1475). A grant that rested only on the judge decision can therefore end in a review run that may edit workflows.
  WHY: This matches behaviour before #9987, so it is not a regression. It runs only after all three judge-capable dispatches have failed. Suggested fix: prefix the call with `MERGE_TRAIN_ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=false` and change the `calls[3]` assertion in `tests/test_review_merge_train.py::test_no_force_wrapper_falls_back_to_the_plain_review_dispatch` to `allow_workflow_edits=false` (about 2 lines).
- NOTE: Rejected the glob concern on `"pending ${elig_login}"` (quoted arm; login limited at line 3326). Rejected the hard-coded wrapper list in `scripts/review_merge_train.sh` lines 1529-1535 (deliberately limited to wrappers that declare `force_rb_judge`). Marks `tests/test_workflow_file_size_limit.py` "unmet" as not a gap in this PR: it also fails on the merge-base, and the PR changes no workflow file.
